Community members are welcome to attend Council Meetings to view from the Gallery. Alternatively, you can access Council meetings electronically via YouTube.

Council assessment panel

About the Panel

The City of Unley Council Assessment Panel (formerly known as the Development Assessment Panel or DAP) is an autonomous planning authority and operates under the Terms of Reference(PDF, 231KB) assigned by the City of Unley Council Policy 1.1.05 established in accordance with the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act.

The Council Assessment Panel (CAP) considers development applications and makes planning decisions. The current membership of the City of Unley Council Assessment Panel consists of the five members.

The Council Assessment Panel is convened under the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act. This means that:

  • It is not convened under the Local Government Act
  • It is not a subcommittee of the Unley Council.
 

The Council Assessment Panel Meeting Procedures(PDF, 123KB) set out the procedures that apply for all meetings of the CAP. Members of the panel are also subject to a ministerial Code of Conduct(PDF, 227KB).

Please see the Council Assessment Panel Policy(PDF, 96KB) relating to an application for review of a decision of the Assessment Manager before lodging your application with Council. Please note that you can only lodge a review of a decision for applications dealt with under the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act 2016. 

Review of a Decision of the Assessment Manager application form.(PDF, 130KB)

Panel Members

Members of the current Council Assessment Panel are:

  • Mr Brenton Burman (Presiding Member)
  • Ms Colleen Dunn
  • Mr David Brown
  • Mr Terry Sutcliffe
  • Ms Yvonne Svensson
  • Mr David Storey (Deputy Independent Member)*
 
This panel has a term of 2 years commencing March 2025.

*Will only act if an Independent Member is unable to attend the Panel meeting.

Agendas & Minutes

Meetings of the Council Assessment Panel are generally held on the third Tuesday of the month at 6pm.
 
Agendas for Council Assessment Panel meetings are available two working days before CAP meetings. Minutes taken at the meeting are available within four working days.

Community members are welcome to attend Council Meetings to view from the Gallery. Alternatively, you can access Council meetings electronically via YouTube.

Council assessment panel

About the Panel

The City of Unley Council Assessment Panel (formerly known as the Development Assessment Panel or DAP) is an autonomous planning authority and operates under the Terms of Reference(PDF, 231KB) assigned by the City of Unley Council Policy 1.1.05 established in accordance with the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act.

The Council Assessment Panel (CAP) considers development applications and makes planning decisions. The current membership of the City of Unley Council Assessment Panel consists of the five members.

The Council Assessment Panel is convened under the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act. This means that:

  • It is not convened under the Local Government Act
  • It is not a subcommittee of the Unley Council.
 

The Council Assessment Panel Meeting Procedures(PDF, 123KB) set out the procedures that apply for all meetings of the CAP. Members of the panel are also subject to a ministerial Code of Conduct(PDF, 227KB).

Please see the Council Assessment Panel Policy(PDF, 96KB) relating to an application for review of a decision of the Assessment Manager before lodging your application with Council. Please note that you can only lodge a review of a decision for applications dealt with under the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act 2016. 

Review of a Decision of the Assessment Manager application form.(PDF, 130KB)

Panel Members

Members of the current Council Assessment Panel are:

  • Mr Brenton Burman (Presiding Member)
  • Ms Colleen Dunn
  • Mr David Brown
  • Mr Terry Sutcliffe
  • Ms Yvonne Svensson
  • Mr David Storey (Deputy Independent Member)*
 
This panel has a term of 2 years commencing March 2025.

*Will only act if an Independent Member is unable to attend the Panel meeting.

Agendas & Minutes

Meetings of the Council Assessment Panel are generally held on the third Tuesday of the month at 6pm.
 
Agendas for Council Assessment Panel meetings are available two working days before CAP meetings. Minutes taken at the meeting are available within four working days.

Council assessment panel

About the Panel

The City of Unley Council Assessment Panel (formerly known as the Development Assessment Panel or DAP) is an autonomous planning authority and operates under the Terms of Reference(PDF, 231KB) assigned by the City of Unley Council Policy 1.1.05 established in accordance with the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act.

The Council Assessment Panel (CAP) considers development applications and makes planning decisions. The current membership of the City of Unley Council Assessment Panel consists of the five members.

The Council Assessment Panel is convened under the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act. This means that:

  • It is not convened under the Local Government Act
  • It is not a subcommittee of the Unley Council.
 

The Council Assessment Panel Meeting Procedures(PDF, 123KB) set out the procedures that apply for all meetings of the CAP. Members of the panel are also subject to a ministerial Code of Conduct(PDF, 227KB).

Please see the Council Assessment Panel Policy(PDF, 96KB) relating to an application for review of a decision of the Assessment Manager before lodging your application with Council. Please note that you can only lodge a review of a decision for applications dealt with under the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act 2016. 

Review of a Decision of the Assessment Manager application form.(PDF, 130KB)

Panel Members

Members of the current Council Assessment Panel are:

  • Mr Brenton Burman (Presiding Member)
  • Ms Colleen Dunn
  • Mr David Brown
  • Mr Terry Sutcliffe
  • Ms Yvonne Svensson
  • Mr David Storey (Deputy Independent Member)*
 
This panel has a term of 2 years commencing March 2025.

*Will only act if an Independent Member is unable to attend the Panel meeting.

Agendas & Minutes

Meetings of the Council Assessment Panel are generally held on the third Tuesday of the month at 6pm.
 
Agendas for Council Assessment Panel meetings are available two working days before CAP meetings. Minutes taken at the meeting are available within four working days.

The Council Assessment Panel is convened under the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act. This means that:

  • It is not convened under the Local Government Act
  • It is not a subcommittee of the Unley Council.
 

The Council Assessment Panel Meeting Procedures(PDF, 123KB) set out the procedures that apply for all meetings of the CAP. Members of the panel are also subject to a ministerial Code of Conduct(PDF, 227KB).

Please see the Council Assessment Panel Policy(PDF, 96KB) relating to an application for review of a decision of the Assessment Manager before lodging your application with Council. Please note that you can only lodge a review of a decision for applications dealt with under the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act 2016. 

Review of a Decision of the Assessment Manager application form.(PDF, 130KB)

Panel Members

Members of the current Council Assessment Panel are:

  • Mr Brenton Burman (Presiding Member)
  • Ms Colleen Dunn
  • Mr David Brown
  • Mr Terry Sutcliffe
  • Ms Yvonne Svensson
  • Mr David Storey (Deputy Independent Member)*
 
This panel has a term of 2 years commencing March 2025.

*Will only act if an Independent Member is unable to attend the Panel meeting.

Agendas & Minutes

Meetings of the Council Assessment Panel are generally held on the third Tuesday of the month at 6pm.
 
Agendas for Council Assessment Panel meetings are available two working days before CAP meetings. Minutes taken at the meeting are available within four working days.
